eventClusters.statement: Gold reached record highs above $2,000 as low real yields, dollar weakness, monetary stimulus and pandemic uncertainty reinforced the monetary/defensive demand regime, but the rapid move created substantial expectation-absorption risk.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: The gold macro thesis was widely visible after a vertical rally. Deep research must distinguish sustainable mine cash-flow leverage from simply chasing the commodity high.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Which A-share gold producers, if any, still had acceptable normalized earnings/cash-flow paths after the record-gold rerating?

eventClusters.statement: A Xinjiang polysilicon plant accident and pandemic disruptions caused a sharp polysilicon price rise that propagated into wafer and module pricing, creating a direct upstream supply-scarcity opportunity but a margin headwind for downstream buyers.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Physical scarcity is real but single-origin at discovery and downstream demand remained incomplete. Deep research must map listed-company upstream exposure and duration rather than assume the entire PV chain benefits.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Is there a low-cost polysilicon producer with realized/quantitative price-to-profit conversion and an acceptable normalized path?

eventClusters.statement: China NEV monthly sales returned to positive year-on-year growth in July and accelerated further in August, while the broader auto market also recovered, creating an early post-pandemic volume inflection.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Monthly growth returned from a depressed base; cumulative YTD NEV sales were still deeply down. Deep research must separate a real structural turn from low-base normalization.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Which listed NEV/battery expressions had a realized earnings bridge and still-reasonable expectations at this early recovery point?

eventClusters.statement: Server DRAM pricing and demand weakened through August-September as excess server inventory built, with a projected 13-18% Q4 price decline and a one-to-two-quarter inventory correction.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: This is a negative physical signal. The Skill should fail closed unless a company has a clearly differentiated counter-engine.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Should memory names be avoided despite the broader economic recovery?

eventClusters.statement: China manufacturing production and new orders remained expansionary through August and strengthened further in September, confirming a broad recovery backdrop.
